prompts.master: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE entirely new game sprite master of Lumine, female Traveler from Genshin Impact, original white/pale blue/gold outfit and original white-gold boots. Supplied official face icon is identity reference only: golden eyes, short blond hair and white flower. This is a NEW master for consistent walking animation, not an illustration or attack pose. Full body from head through both boots, held one-handed sword fully visible, on true transparency, generous empty padding. Crisp refined pixel-art clusters, clear readable silhouette and limited palette, matching polished anime-inspired 2D fighting-game sprites. Camera fixed, nearly side profile facing RIGHT, slight three-quarter face so both eyes not front-on. Upright neutral standing pose. Both legs straight but relaxed, feet under hips and slightly apart, neither leg in exaggerated lunge. Anatomically natural youthful adult proportions, head neither chibi large nor miniature. Keep facial detail readable. Right hand firmly wraps a dark hilt behind gold crossguard, short plain silver one-handed sword pointing diagonally down-right, wrist straight; fingers must grip hilt instead of guard/blade. Left arm relaxed beside torso, small clearance. Torso, chest, pelvis and head form one stable upright column. White skirt panels must leave both knees, lower legs and boot soles readable, fabric rests with restrained volume instead of flying sideways. Cape ribbons hang down/back in a compact shape, no huge wind. Mild warm/cool cel shading, no gradients or tiny noisy texture. Both feet share one ground level, nothing cropped. No multiple poses, no duplicate figures, no text, no effects, no ground shadow, no scene. Choose this neutral stance to be reused as the exact same head, torso and weapon reference across future movement frames.
